Team red usually has an advantage on E2M2 but disadvantage on E1M5. ** Standings determined by won games, followed by won rounds followed by total frag difference. * '''Grand Final BO5''' ** Top two teams will meet in the final. ** 4on4 (3on3 if one team can´t get a full squad or a stand-in that is accepted by the other team). ** Best of five, where 2 x 10 min rounds on E2M2 and CTF8. Everyone is welcome to participate. All info in [https://discord.gg/uaMKvnDpwz CTF Discord]. *'''How to get started with CTF''' ** Bind the hook with +fire 22 , or impulse 22 (bind q +fire 22) for example. ** Bind tossrune, to throw away your current rune: (bind r tossrune) for example. ** Practice your hook skills and config on a KTX-server. For example: connect london.badplace.eu:28503, in the console, type: ctf, then type: practice. ** The map Mammoth by Alice are at the moment only available on de.aye.wtf:27501. __NOTOC__
